column3:
• Regular inspection of work sites to check
for presence of potential temporary
breeding habitats will be conducted.

column2:
Potential social conflicts if workers from
other regions or countries are hired
column3:
• Civil works are expected to be minor.
Only locally unavailable skilled labour will
be hired from other regions and most of
others works will be carried out by the
local workforce to avoid any such
conflicts.

column2:
Large population influx during project
construction that causes increased burden
on social infrastructure and services (such
as water supply and sanitation systems)
column3:
• Civil works are considered to be minor.
Local workforce will be given preference.
• Sufficient separate sanitary facilities and
water shall be provided to the labor force
to avoid any such conflict or contact with
the local people.

column2:
Community safety risks due to both
accidental and natural causes, especially
where the structural elements or
components of the project are accessible to
members of the affected community or
where their failure could result in injury to
the community during construction period
column3:
• Appropriate design features to meet
national and international standards will
be included, and measures/plans and
procedures will be implemented to
minimize risks.
• Unauthorized public access to the
construction sites and laboratories will be
prohibited.
• Environmental audit and risk assessment
will be conducted during implementation

column2:
Generation of wastes and other construction
debris
column3:
• Contractor will be required to reduce
waste generation, whenever feasible.
General municipal waste and hazardous
wastes to be screened at source,
separated and disposed temporarily in
the bin at two different designated
locations as non-hazardous designated
place and hazardous materials
designated places for time-bound
disposals.
• Accordingly, non-hazardous will be
disposed to designated municipality
owned disposal site.
• Generation of solid waste will comply
with relevant provisions in the City
Corporation Act 2009 on waste removal,
collection and management and maintain
3R.
• Hazardous wastes will be disposed of at
designated disposal sites following the
requirements of Basel Convention.
• Construction area will be separated with
temporary barriers to avoid potential
infection from the hospital premises to
the construction workers

column2:
Wastewater discharges during renovation of
existing facilities and potential for
contamination of drinking water pipeline
column3:
• Sewage water runoff will be collected
through separate internal drainage
system to a temporary impermeable pit
